card.name: Digits inside years and numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit, mostly the 2 that starts a year like 2007 to 2012 after a month or 'By'/'In'. Also a 0 inside a number such as 1,500.

modes.description: The first digit '2' of a 2000s year right after a month, day or 'In'/'By'.

modes.description: A zero in the middle of a comma-grouped count.

card.writes: It pushes toward number-scale words such as million, billion and percent signs, and away from word-part pieces.
card.plain: It fires on the digits of a date or large number as it is being written out.
